layman_headline: Fear is gripping the crypto market — patience beats impulse right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful state with most coins down 5-12% over the past week. Bitcoin itself has dropped about 3% and is pulling altcoins down with it. While a few coins are showing early signs of bouncing, none of them present a clean enough setup with strong enough supporting data to justify opening a new position right now. The best move is to wait for the fear to either deepen into a clear oversold bounce opportunity, or for a catalyst to shift momentum.
layman_action: Stay in cash for now. The market is scared but not panicking enough to create a clear bargain. Watch for Bitcoin to either stabilize above $62,000 or drop sharply below $60,000 — either scenario would create a clearer trading opportunity than what we see today.
expert_reasoning: I evaluated all seven candidates systematically. KAITO has bearish candle patterns and elevated RSI (65) despite a -18% daily drop — a trap. BONK and TRUMP have oversold RSIs (25 and 26), which per signal credibility data is our most reliable indicator (71% win rate), but both have deeply bearish chart structures with price below all MAs. ENA has the strongest bullish chart signal (engulfing + marubozu) but a terrible risk/reward ratio of 0.56x. WLD offers the best R/R at 2.41x but is in a downtrend below all MAs. With Fear & Greed at 28 (near my validated rule threshold of 25), BTC dominance at 56.3% crushing alts, and the Coldcard exploit news still creating uncertainty, no candidate clears the bar for a confident entry. A HOLD preserves capital for a better setup.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 28 and worsening — could slide into extreme fear territory, dragging all alts down further
BTC dominance at 56.3% means capital is flowing out of alts into Bitcoin — a headwind for any alt position
Coldcard exploit news is creating sell pressure and could cascade into broader security concerns
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — if it drops below 25, my validated rules say ambiguity increases and a HOLD is safest; if it bounces above 35, alt setups improve
BONK and TRUMP RSI levels — if they drop below 20 while showing volume divergence, that becomes a high-conviction oversold bounce play
Bitcoin price action around $62,000 support — a decisive break below could accelerate alt selling, while a bounce could unlock the ENA or WLD setups
market_context: The crypto market is in a fear regime (28/100) with BTC down 3% weekly and alts underperforming significantly. The Coldcard exploit is dominating headlines and driving sub-1 BTC holders to move coins to exchanges, adding sell-side pressure.
context_banner: Market fear is elevated but not extreme — the best swing trades emerge when fear peaks and reverses, not while it's still worsening.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 28 with a worsening trend (week avg 27.6) — close to the 25 threshold where my validated rules say outcomes become genuinely ambiguous.
BONK (25.3) and TRUMP (26.2) are oversold, which is my most reliable signal historically (71% win rate), but bearish chart structures on both reduce conviction.
Coldcard hack triggered the biggest sub-1 BTC movement since FTX — a significant security-driven sell catalyst that hasn't fully played out.
The $89M Coldcard exploit is causing investors to send BTC back to exchanges, increasing potential sell pressure in the near term.
ENA's 12% daily surge with bullish engulfing candles suggests genuine buying interest, but the 0.56x risk/reward ratio makes it a poor entry at current levels.
